description: Creating a survival game which takes place on Titan.
summary:
I wanted to create a survival game on Titan, saturn's moon. It is composed of different missions you need to do in order to survive on the planet, almost like a guide so the player or the players aren't too lost. It uses real life chemistry and physics so it has an educational aspect.  It adresses the challenge as the player has to make choices in what to build or create first and if not done it the right order it has an impact on your mission. It is a fun way to learn about different physics and chemistry concepts. 
This game can also be played by multiple players at the same to encourage collaboration and so it allows people to learn together.
details:
It was supposed to be a first person POV survival game to play on a computer or on a smartphone. I want people to discover a new part of the solar system which isn't very know in people my age. I also want people to enjoy the more educational aspects of it and enjoy learning new chemistry and physics concepts.

This project has not been coded yet, the visual have all been drawn by hand using various mediums.
